王野从秦家出来后直奔了曹强家，强子也是刚吃完饭。正在客厅里跟父母聊天，王野进院就喊：“强子在家吗？”

曹强一听是王野的声音赶紧跑出来傻乐着：“哥，你来啦。”

王野对这个傻乎乎的师弟其实挺喜欢的，听话，实在。谁对他好，他就全心全意的对谁好。王野边走边说道：“强子，你爹在吗？”

曹强：“在屋里呢。”多余的的话一句都不问，要是别人总得问一句找他爹干什么吧。

王野前面走，曹强就在王野半个身位后跟着。一进门王野看见曹大军正在和曹母说话，见到王野两人赶紧起身。虽然他们是长辈儿，但是王野可是在教导他家大儿子，最起码的尊重还是有的。

王野上前打招呼道：“曹叔，曹婶今天我过来是为了强子。明天我就要出趟差，强子的功夫也要进行下一步了。”

曹大军：“小野，你就说需要叔做啥就行了。”

王野笑呵呵的说道：“曹叔，这次不用什么，找个大浴桶和药罐子就行。”

曹母抱着个小姑娘：“这些家里都是现成的，我去给你准备。”

王野手伸进包里，从空间中取出半份药浴的材料。这也就是有空间要是自己挑，还不如重新配一份快呢。

没一会儿曹母拿着一个药罐子就回来了，递给王野：“小野，你看看这个行不？”

王野：“曹婶，这没啥要求能用就行。”

王野又对曹强说道：“强子你去烧水，把你家的浴桶装到七分满。”

曹强听到王野的吩咐，转身就出去了。王野也拿着药罐子在曹母的引导下来到了厨房。

在王野熬药时曹母也在旁帮忙，到后来就是王野在旁边看着，曹母在操作。王野也没闲着，开始逗弄起了曹母怀里的小丫头。

这应该就是曹强嘴里那个好玩的妹妹，王野逗弄了一会儿觉得这小丫头确实好玩儿，这么一个小布丁一点儿都不认生。王野手里拿着一块儿剖开半截的大白兔。小丫头就抱着王野的手在那里吮吸。

吸一会儿还抬头对着王野咯咯的笑笑，啊呀呀的说着王野听不懂的话。时间飞快，药和水都准备好了，王野又进浴室调整了一下水温才把汤药倒进去。在曹大军的担忧下王野让曹强进入浴桶。

也不能怪曹大军担忧，一般人哪洗过这么热的澡呀。但是就算很担心曹大军也一言没发，曹强进入后烫的紧咬牙关。

王野尴尬的看向曹大军：“那个，曹叔接下来那个......”。

曹大军立刻明白后面的东西人家要保密了，打了声招呼就出去了。

王野伸出一只手按在曹强的肩膀：“强子，接下来按我说的节奏呼吸。”

曹强点点：“知道了哥。”

王野开始按照当时赵爷爷教他时的办法开始教导曹强。

可是接下来的事情王野吃了一惊，曹强这个傻大个儿学起招式来费老劲了。可是学习呼吸法太快了，这速度都快赶上王野了。没几分钟曹强就开始进入了睡眠状态。这可能就是心思单纯的好处。

王野又感受了一会儿他的呼吸，已经按照呼吸法不停的循环了。王野收回按在曹强肩膀上的手，摸着浴桶把沉底的药渣收进空间，才出了浴室。

曹大军见王野出来了，赶紧上前问道：“小野怎么样，强子没问题吧？”

Wang Ye went straight to Cao Qiang's house after coming out of Qin's house, and Qiangzi had just finished eating.While chatting with his parents in the living room, Wang Ye entered the hospital and shouted: "Is Qiangzi at home?"

When Cao Qiang heard Wang Ye's voice, he quickly ran out and said with a silly smile: "Brother, you are here."

Wang Ye actually liked this silly junior brother, he was obedient and honest.Whoever treats him well will be treated wholeheartedly.Wang Ye said as he walked: "Qiangzi, is your father here?"

Cao Qiang: "It's in the house." He didn't ask any extra questions. If someone else had to ask him what he was looking for, he would ask.

Wang Ye walked in front, and Cao Qiang followed Wang Ye half way behind.As soon as he entered the door, Wang Ye saw Cao Dajun talking to Cao's mother. When they saw Wang Ye, they quickly stood up.Although they are elders, Wang Ye is teaching his eldest son, and he still has the most basic respect.

Wang Ye stepped forward and said hello: "Uncle Cao, Aunt Cao, I came here today for Qiangzi. I will be on a business trip tomorrow, and Qiangzi's kung fu will also take the next step."

Cao Dajun: "Xiaoye, just tell me what you need me to do."

Wang Ye said with a smile: "Uncle Cao, we don't need anything this time, just find a big bathtub and a medicine jar."

Mother Cao held a little girl in her arms and said, "These are all ready-made at home. I'll prepare them for you."

Wang Ye reached into his bag and took out half of the medicinal bath materials from the space.This means that if you have space and choose it yourself, it’s better to get a new one.

After a while, Mother Cao came back with a medicine jar and handed it to Wang Ye: "Xiao Ye, can you take a look at this?"

Wang Ye: "Aunt Cao, I just need to use it without any requirements."

Wang Ye said to Cao Qiang again: "Qiangzi, go and boil water and fill your bathtub until it is seventy percent full."

Cao Qiang heard Wang Ye's instructions, turned around and went out.Wang Ye also took the medicine jar and came to the kitchen under the guidance of Cao's mother.

Cao's mother was also helping when Wang Ye was boiling the medicine. Later, Wang Ye was watching and Cao's mother was doing the operation.Wang Ye was not idle either and began to tease the little girl in Mother Cao's arms.

This should be the fun sister Cao Qiang talked about. Wang Ye teased her for a while and felt that this little girl was really fun. Such a little pudding didn't recognize life at all.Wang Ye held a piece of white rabbit cut into half.The little girl held Wang Ye's hand and sucked it.

After sucking for a while, he raised his head and giggled at Wang Ye, saying words that Wang Ye couldn't understand.Time flies, the medicine and water are ready, Wang Ye goes into the bathroom again and adjusts the water temperature before pouring the medicine in.Under Cao Dajun's concerns, Wang Ye asked Cao Qiang to enter the bathtub.

You can't blame Cao Dajun for being worried. Most people have never had such a hot bath.But even though Cao Dajun was worried, he didn't say a word. Cao Qiang gritted his teeth after entering.

Wang Ye looked at Cao Dajun awkwardly: "That, Uncle Cao's next...".

Cao Dajun immediately understood that the things behind him were going to be kept secret, so he said hello and went out.

Wang Ye stretched out a hand and put it on Cao Qiang's shoulder: "Qiangzi, breathe according to the rhythm I told you."

Cao Qiang nodded: "I understand, brother."

Wang Ye began to teach Cao Qiang the same way Grandpa Zhao taught him.

But what happened next surprised Wang Ye. Cao Qiang, a big fool like him, had a hard time learning the moves.But he learned the breathing method so quickly that he almost caught up with Wang Ye.Within a few minutes, Cao Qiang began to fall asleep.This may be the benefit of being simple-minded.

Wang Ye felt his breathing for a while, and it was already circulating according to the breathing method.Wang Ye withdrew his hand from Cao Qiang's shoulder, touched the tub and collected the medicine residue at the bottom into the space before leaving the bathroom.

When Cao Dajun saw Wang Ye coming out, he quickly stepped forward and asked, "How is Xiaoye? Is Qiangzi okay?"
